hxlistbox.h File Reference

Detailed Description

This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit listbox widget API. A listbox is a widget containing a list of strings.

#define HxListBoxAddItem ( a,
b,
c   )     HxListAddItem((HxList_t*)a,b,c)

Add an item to a list box.

HxListBoxAddItem adds a new item to a list box.

An item is a null-terminated string with an optional image.

The incoming pIndex argument is the index into the array of items where the item should be inserted. If pIndex is less than 0, or if pIndex is greater than the existing number of items in the list, the new item is appended to the list. The index where the new item was inserted is returned in the outgoing pIndex.

Parameters:
pListBox IN: Pointer to a list box
pText IN: Null-terminated string
pIndex IN/OUT: Pointer to index where item is to be inserted
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

#define HxListBoxRemoveItem ( a,
b   )     HxListRemoveItem((HxList_t*)a,b)

Remove item from a list box.

HxListBoxRemoveItem removes an item from a list box.

HX_INVALID_ARG is returned if index is less than 0. Since the index into the array of list items is zero-based, HX_INVALID_ARG is also returned if index is greater or equal to the number of items in the list.

Parameters:
pListBox IN: Pointer to a list box
index IN: Index of item to be removed
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful. Returns HX_INVALID_ARG if index is invalid.

HxResult HxListBoxDelete ( HxListBox_t *  pListBox  ) 

Delete a list widget.

HxListBoxDelete deletes a list created from an earlier call to HxListBoxNew.

It is not necessary to call this function when quitting the application, since the widget's parent calls this function just before the parent is deleted. HxListBoxDelete only needs to be called when removing a list at runtime.

Parameters:
pListBox IN: Pointer to the list to delete
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxListBoxExtendedNew ( uint32_t  id,
HxWidget_t *  pParent,
const HxRectangle_t *  pRect,
int32_t  count,
int32_t  itemHeight,
HxListBox_t **  hListBox 
)

Create an extended listbox widget.

An extended listbox is a custom listbox whose drawing and behavior is controlled by the application. The application is responsible for drawing each item in the listbox, which allows the application to create items with multiple strings and/or icons.

After creating the extended listbox, HxListBoxExtendedGetListExtended returns the list object that can be used with the extended list API defined in hxlistextended.h.

Parameters:
id IN: Unique ID for the widget, defined by app, or kHxWidgetAutoID to auto-generate the ID
pParent IN: Pointer to "parent" widget
pRect IN: Pointer to rectangle describing the position and size of the control
count IN: Count of items in the listbox
itemHeight IN: Height of each item in the listbox
hListBox OUT: Handle to the extended listbox, NULL on failure
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful. Returns HX_MEMORY_ERROR if memory allocation fails.

HxResult HxListBoxNew ( uint32_t  id,
HxWidget_t *  pParent,
const HxRectangle_t *  pBounds,
const char *const *  hText,
int32_t  count,
HxListBox_t **  hListBox 
)

Create a listbox widget.

HxListBoxNew creates a new listbox widget.

The height of pRect is the maximum height of the control. Additional strings are accessed by scrolling through the list. HxListBoxGetBounds can be called before creating the listbox in order to pass in an appropriately sized rectangle.

HxListSetColor and HxListSetFont can be used to customize the look of a listbox.

Parameters:
id IN: Unique ID for the widget, defined by app, or kHxWidgetAutoID to auto-generate the ID
pParent IN: Pointer to "parent" widget
pBounds IN: Pointer to rectangle describing the position and size of the control
hText IN: Pointer to the array of strings
count IN: Count of strings in hText
hListBox OUT: Handle to the created listbox, NULL on failure
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful. Returns HX_MEMORY_ERROR if memory allocation fails.
